close_reason: Landed. JmapUrl and JmapUrlTemplate typed wrappers distinguish plain JMAP URLs from RFC 6570 Level-1 templates at the type level. Session.api_url is JmapUrl; download_url, upload_url, event_source_url are JmapUrlTemplate. DownloadBlobParams and UploadBlobParams take &JmapUrlTemplate (compiler refuses mis-applied calls). No Deref<Target=str> — auto-coercion would defeat the type distinction. Existing extension-client call sites that use session.api_url.as_str() are unchanged because the typed wrapper exposes the same .as_str() method. 4 new unit tests cover the type distinction (compile-time witness), serde round-trip, and PartialEq<&str> ergonomics.
description:
request.rs:119, 125, 130, 136 — pub api_url, download_url, upload_url, event_source_url

Of these four:
  - api_url: plain URL (no template variables)
  - download_url: RFC 6570 Level-1 URI template with {accountId}, {blobId}, {type}, {name}
  - upload_url: template with {accountId}
  - event_source_url: template with {types}, {closeafter}, {ping}

All four are `pub String`. A caller cannot tell from the type which need expansion. The doc-comments on each field do say "URI Template (level 1)" or not, but that's text-only — the compiler doesn't enforce it.

A consumer who writes:
  client.call(&session.upload_url, &req).await?

…passes a template (containing literal `{accountId}` characters) to a function that expects a plain URL. The function passes it to reqwest::Client::post, which percent-encodes the braces, sends a request to "https://server/upload/%7BaccountId%7D/", and the server returns 404 or similar. The caller debugs forever.

This is the inverse of the api_url/upload_url confusion in JMAP-6r7c.39: same root cause, complementary symptom.

The right shape is two typed wrappers:
  pub struct JmapUrl(String);          // plain
  pub struct JmapUrlTemplate(String);   // requires expansion

With session.api_url: JmapUrl and session.upload_url: JmapUrlTemplate. The compiler then refuses to mix them up. expand_url_template takes JmapUrlTemplate and returns JmapUrl.

Cost: every existing caller that touches these fields needs to update. Even &session.api_url becomes &session.api_url.as_str() or impl Deref<Target=str>. Pre-1.0 this is fine; post-1.0 the change requires a major bump.

Low priority because (a) it's text-documented, (b) discoverable through testing, (c) workaround is "always pass the right one". But it's a real defensive-code-forcing gap that a typed wrapper would close. Flagging now so the next major bump can land it.
title: Session URLs do not have a typed wrapper distinguishing template URLs from plain URLs
